description: Meaning-based (vector + keyword hybrid) search over the full text of every paper page, practitioner guide, learning path, calculator and post, via Cloudflare AI Search. Use it for natural-language questions ("does momentum survive transaction costs in crypto?") or when search_papers' exact keyword matching finds nothing. Returns pages with a relevance score, a snippet of the best-matching chunk and, for papers, the scores and labels. No filters beyond kind; for structured filtering use search_papers. Metered upstream: at most 25 results per call, and a daily budget; when it is exhausted the tool says so and search_papers keeps working.

min_score.description: Drop matches below this relevance score.

rewrite.description: Let the service rewrite the query for retrieval first (one extra model call).

name: semantic_search
title: Semantic search over papers, guides and tools
